text: {"name":"rxu_cntrl_spurious","confidence":"high","docstring":"Handles a suspicious received 802.11 control frame by finding its matching RX context and invoking the deauthentication callback when the transmitter is absent from the context's linked list.","subsystem":"mac","var_renames":{"v2":"rx_context_table","v3":"context_index","i":"context_ptr","v6":"context_offset","v7":"peer_list_entry"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":38,"meaning":"MAC address in a linked-list entry, compared with the frame transmitter address"},{"offset":100,"meaning":"six-byte context MAC address, compared with the frame receiver address"},{"offset":106,"meaning":"context state; value 2 is required"},{"offset":108,"meaning":"context active or valid flag"},{"offset":240,"meaning":"head pointer for the linked list of peer entries"}]}
